# Audit Phase

Perform an independent audit of the phase or subphase I identify.

Reconstruct the applicable requirements from authoritative repository evidence before judging the implementation. Inspect the relevant specification, implementation plan, roadmap, implementation, tests, permanent closure suites, and prior audit evidence.

For every finding:
- make it reproducible;
- classify its severity and affected contract;
- distinguish observed evidence from inference;
- identify the root cause rather than only the visible symptom;
- state the verification that would prove closure.

Do not approve by intent. Do not rewrite historical evidence.

Do not remediate findings in the same audit pass unless I explicitly ask you to switch from independent audit to remediation.
